author: GitHub
description:
GitHub Code Quality is now generally available, giving developers and engineering leaders a shared view of software health. By combining deterministic CodeQL analysis with AI-assisted findings, it catches reliability issues before they reach production. Watch how Copilot Autofix proposes corrections directly in your pull request, allowing you to review and commit fixes without leaving your context. Set up rulesets to enforce quality standards at the merge boundary today.

#GitHub #CodeQuality #GitHubCopilot 

Learn more about GitHub Code Quality: https://github.com/features/code-quality

GitHub Code Quality is now generally available: https://github.blog/changelog/2026-07-20-github-code-quality-is-now-generally-available/
